places.name: Torres del Paine National Park (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, Torres del Paine National Park is renowned for its dramatic mountains, glaciers, and pristine lakes.
places.place_tip: Hire a guide for the best trekking experience.
places.address: Torres del Paine, Patagonia, Chile

places.ai_summary: Isla Magdalena is home to a large colony of Magellanic penguins, located on a scenic island in the Strait of Magellan.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for better wildlife viewing.
places.address: Isla Magdalena, Patagonia, Chile
